Fixture.Title: Container color laboratory
Fixture.Heading: See the shell respond.
Fixture.Intro: Scroll down to compact the floating chrome. Scroll upward to expand it. The App WebView mode removes browser chrome and restores the full native viewport.
Fixture.Active: Theme-color: orchid. This fixture does not modify the calibration page.
Fixture.OceanBody: With the theme hint removed, the macOS host samples an actual native WKWebView snapshot near the chrome edge. A background gradient is raster content, not just a computed CSS color.
Fixture.SunsetBody: The desktop uses platform material and adjustable tint, blend, shadow and radius. It approximates Safari layout; its optics are not measured iOS Liquid Glass.
Fixture.NightBody: The container reports its actual viewport, scroll state, tint source and platform material. Unknown optical and physical parameters stay unknown.
